profile_text.body:
Obsidian is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in Los Angeles, California, that makes a free, flexible note-taking and knowledge management application. The company describes its software as a private, local-first tool that stores notes directly on a user's device, accessible offline, with no server-side access even by Obsidian itself. The application supports personal notes, journaling, knowledge bases, and project management, and includes features such as bidirectional note linking, an interactive relationship graph, a limitless canvas for brainstorming, and an open plugin API with thousands of community extensions.

The site's held facts classify Obsidian's primary AI offering as Obsidian AI, categorized under notes, knowledge, and meetings, and described as a local-first knowledge AI that is privacy-focused and carries no cloud dependency. Two third-party MCP servers are registered against the product: one connects AI assistants to a GitHub-hosted Obsidian vault for access and search, and another allows AI assistants to search a vault by title or keyword and summarize related content. No litigation is recorded against the company, though California is noted as its primary legal exposure jurisdiction with 175 associated entries.
